items.title: Strengthening public health practice: a new UK-wide framework for all nurses and midwives
items.summary: British Journal of Nursing, Ahead of Print.

items.title: New public health framework ‘celebrates’ role of nurses and midwives
items.summary: The government has today launched a UK-wide framework aimed at recognising and harnessing the “important role” of nurses and midwives in public health.

items.title: Nursing and midwifery public health practice framework
Survival is only the beginning: a reflection for World Prematurity Day
items.summary: RCN Fellow Tendai Nzirawa describes her niece's journey after birth at 28+2 weeks, with community neonatal nursing and follow-up support, arguing for accessible family-centred follow-up care after neonatal discharge. Theme: invest in follow-up care.

items.title: Interprofessional simulation in prehospital maternity care: learning from joint training
items.summary:
Background:
Effective interprofessional collaboration is critical in prehospital maternity emergencies, yet opportunities for paramedic and midwifery students to learn together are limited.

items.title: Concern over closure of understaffed maternity unit
items.summary: The suspension of an understaffed maternity unit in Northern Ireland has prompted criticism and warnings about a “workforce crisis” in rural UK regions.

items.title: NMC officially launches four-year midwifery regulation strategy
items.summary: The Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) has officially launched its four-year strategy for midwifery regulation, following approval by the regulator’s governing council in September.

items.title: US FDA 510(k) — Arctic Sun Neonatal ArcticGel Pad
Working night shifts during pregnancy linked to developmental delays
items.summary: Women who work night shifts throughout pregnancy are more likely to have children with development delays at age 4, a new study has found.
